adjudication.rationale: In `lib/tasks/disqus.thor`, the importer now does `post = TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])` and then unconditionally iterates `t[:posts].each` to import replies when `post.present?`. From `TopicEmbed.import`/`import_remote`, if an embed for the same `url` already exists, it returns the existing `embed.post` (updating it only if `content_sha1` changed) rather than creating a new topic. The diff shows no guard around the subsequent reply-import loop to detect already-imported Disqus comments, so rerunning the Thor task would re-add the same replies into the existing topic, duplicating them.
